decisions.reason: Although it is only mentioned rather than given its own page, indicating lower visible commitment and fit with the digitalization direction, the firm has already invested and launched it, so escalation of commitment leads to keeping it for now.
Its own webpage signals stronger public commitment and centrality to the firm's traceability solutions, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely despite any temporary disappointments.
Like product B, having a dedicated page and close alignment with the announced Industry 4.0 direction increases sunk-cost and reputational stakes, making persistence the likely choice.
